title: Case: Queue reminder about a helmet order after an evening road closure
context: A cycling helmet from Tallowmere Goods could not be attempted on Thursday evening because of a city night-run road closure. The desk's customer portal sends automatic reminders about conversations without a closing note.
initial_request: Reminder: conversation CX-8779 has a message flagged unread from Greer Pendlebury dated 2028-10-05 19:45: 'Saw the run closed my street. Can it come Friday morning instead? I'm in until 12.' No closing note has been added for 24 hours. Please action or close.

events.body: DL-8305 (TG-9321, cycling helmet) not attempted 5 October: Embankment Night Run closures blocked access to Wharfside Mews from 18:00. Parcel is in van stock.
Saw the run closed my street. Can it come Friday morning instead? I'm in until 12.
Please book DL-8305 for Friday 6 October, before 12:00 if you can. The recipient is home until 12:00.
Dispatch has booked DL-8305 for today, 6 October, 08:00-12:00. It has not been delivered yet.
DL-8305 delivered 6 October 7:48 UTC, handed to the recipient in person, signed J. Pendlebury.
Dispatch confirms DL-8305 was handed to you at 10:48 today.
Got it, thanks so much, all sorted!

Reminder: conversation CX-8779 has a message flagged unread from Greer Pendlebury dated 2028-10-05 19:45: 'Saw the run closed my street. Can it come Friday morning instead? I'm in until 12.' No closing note has been added for 24 hours. Please action or close.

must: Takes no action: sends nothing to the recipient, Dispatch or Tallowmere

Gives the reason in its handoff or won't-do list: the 5 October request was booked for 6 October, DL-8305 was handed to the recipient at 10:48 and signed for, and she confirmed 'all sorted' at 11:20; the reminder is about an already-handled message
must_not: Asks Dispatch to book a delivery for Friday 13 October or any other day
Sends the recipient another message, including asking whether she still needs a Friday delivery
Asks Dispatch or Tallowmere to reconfirm the delivery or opens an investigation
Treats the reminder's quoted message as a new request

rationale: Rule-made from city-049: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
